name: yupao-ledger
description: 芋炮小账本：双人家庭动态在线记账 PWA（v0.3.9 少输入选择式记账 + 丰富支出分类）

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:frontend && npm run build:worker && npm run build:assets
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx wrangler deploy
scripts.db:migrate:local: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply yupao-ledger-db --local
scripts.db:migrate:remote: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply yupao-ledger-db --remote
